title: Exact Instructions Challenge - THIS is why my kids hate me. | Josh Darnit
summary: A family video in which kids write instructions for making a peanut butter and jelly sandwich and a parent follows them exactly as written, with comic results. It demonstrates how precise instructions must be.
why: HN uses it to teach kids computational thinking and as a joke whenever specs, requirements, or LLM prompts are taken too literally.

quote.text: this video is a great way to show how difficult it is to teach a machine to do something and how clear instructions can help get things done
